content.text: Refresh logic already exists in `TraktImportBase.Fetch`, so I'm checking the callers and `HttpImportListBase` to see why it isn't taking effect.

files.reason: Holds Fetch() and RefreshToken() logic (5-minute expiry check, RenewUri call, swallowed HttpException, persisting via UpdateSettings); the core place to fix token auto-refresh.
Defines AccessToken/RefreshToken/Expires settings and validation rules that gate refresh.
UpdateSettings persists refreshed tokens; if the new token isn't saved, lists break after expiry.
